description: Creates a scheduled job of the app, or replaces the one with that name. Up to 50 per app. Nothing runs until neblla_promote "save". Pause: enabled: false; delete: neblla_delete_automation. More: neblla_get_llms tools/set_automation

action.description: { kind: "openRoom", room, config? } | { kind: "message", room, data } (the room's server file gets it as a hook) | { kind: "callApi", secret, path? }.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

board.description: A scores ranking of the app, instead of table.

day.description: With board: the UTC day (default today).

email.description: booking.reminder: also email the person who booked, from a transactional template (secret then optional)

field.description: With table: the field that ranks them.

hours.description: With table: the period in hours (default 24).

name.description: The automation's name: a letter, then letters, digits, _ or - (up to 40).

path.description: Template: path under the secret's baseUrl.

room.description: Template: a live room whose server file gets the results as a hook.

secret.description: Template: API secret the results go to (required by booking.reminder; the others need secret or room).

table.description: game.dailyTournament: the table whose rows are ranked.

template.description: booking.reminder (set, secret); community.digest; game.dailyTournament: a scores ranking (board) or a table's top rows (table, field, hours).

when.description: { at: future ISO date } | { every: minutes, 5-10080 } | { daily: "HH:MM", days?: [0-6, 0 = Sunday], tz?: IANA zone, default UTC }.

name: neblla_set_automation
title: Schedule an automation
